description: Lists the workspace's keywords with stats, polling status, matching rules and context, plus `total`. With no arguments you get all keywords, latest first. q searches the term and context. You can filter by kind, status (active, muted by someone, paused for balance, noisy when the noise brake paused it, or capped at its monthly mention cap), platform or groupId, order with sort, and page with limit and offset.

groupId.description: Keeps keywords in these groups only (grp_...). Repeat the parameter or separate values with commas.

kind.description: Keeps keywords of these kinds only (brand, competitor, topic). Repeat the parameter or separate values with commas.

limit.description: How many to return, from 1 to 500. Leave it out to get all keywords after `offset`.

platform.description: Keeps keywords that run on one of these platforms. That means the term is searched there, which is every platform when platforms is null. For appstore and googleplay it means an app from that store is in reviewSources. Repeat the parameter or separate values with commas.

items.description: The platform. Review platforms are appstore, googleplay, trustpilot and googlemaps (a place's Google reviews).

q.description: Case-insensitive search in the term and context.

sort.description: newest puts the latest created first and oldest the earliest. term sorts A to Z. mentions puts the most matches first and relevant the most relevant matches. recent puts the most matches of the past 7 days first. lastMention puts the latest matched post first, with keywords that have none at the end.

status.description: Keeps keywords in these states only (active, muted, paused, capped). Repeat the parameter or separate values with commas.

items.description: active means it is running. muted means someone turned it off. paused means it stopped because the balance ran out. noisy means the noise brake stopped it, because most matches were irrelevant on a workspace still on its welcome credit. capped means it reached its monthly mention cap and waits for the next month.

name: list_keywords
title: List keywords
